sources.title: Grounded Language-Image Pre-training - arXiv.org
sources.snippet: Abstract This paper presents a grounded language-image pre-training (GLIP) model for learning object-level, language-aware, and semantic-rich visual representations. GLIP uni-fies object detection and phrase grounding for pre-training.
